First, subtract 6 months from 1573-08-23:  
1573-02-23 (6 months back).  

Then subtract 27 days:  
February 1573 had 28 days (non-leap year).  
Go back 27 days from 1573-02-23:  
Feb 23 → Feb 1 is 22 days back, need 5 more days into January.  
Jan 31 → Jan 27 (5 days before Feb 1).  

So: 1573-01-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1573-01-27
